items.description: Here I tried to reference the most recent article found on specific software since enumerating all changes including the original paper is too cumbersome.

children.title: MPC Hello
children.description: Malicious secure 2PC calculating the larger of two numbers. Also a template repository for building malicious secure 2PC web apps for any circuit.

repo_info.description: The hello-world of MPC.

children.title: MP-SPDZ
children.description: MPC with garbled circuits or secret sharing; secure against malicious or semi-honest adversaries with dishonest or honest majority. | documentation | eprint: 2020/512

repo_info.description: Versatile framework for multi-party computation

children.title: swanky
children.description: A suite of rust libraries for secure multi-party computation (currently includes oblivious transfer, garbled circuits, and private set intersection).

repo_info.description: A suite of Rust libraries for secure multi-party computation.

children.title: SecretFlow-SPU
children.description: A domain-specific compiler and runtime suite, that aims to provide a secure computation service with provable security. SPU compiler uses XLA as its front-end Intermediate Representation (IR) and SPU runtime implements various MPC protocols. | USENIX ATC'23.

repo_info.description: SPU (Secure Processing Unit) aims to be a provable, measurable secure computation device, which provides computation ability while keeping your private data protected.

children.title: MPZ
children.description: A collection of multi-party computation libraries written in Rust 🦀. Strives to provide safe, performant, modular and portable MPC software with a focus on usability.

repo_info.description: Multi-party computation libraries written in Rust 🦀

children.title: JIFF
children.description: JavaScript client and server libraries for building web-based applications that employ general purpose MPC; secure against semi-honest adversaries. | documentation: link.

repo_info.description: JavaScript library for building web-based applications that employ secure multi-party computation (MPC).

children.title: ABY3
children.description: 3PC with secret sharing for privacy preserving machine learning and database joins (PSI, Union, etc.); secure against semi-honest adversaries. | CCS'18, 2019/518.

repo_info.description: A Three Party MPC framework for Machine learning and Databases

children.title: MPC
children.description: Go-based secure two-party computation framework combining a garbled-circuit runtime, the MPCL compiler, circuit tooling, OT primitives, and a WIP BMR implementation.

repo_info.description: Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) framework written in Go. Implements two-party garbled circuits (Yao) and the Goldreich-Micali-Wigderson (GMW) protocol for secure computation.

children.title: Zama KMS
children.description: Zama's MPC-based key management system for threshold key generation and threshold decryption for FHE. | WAHC'23, Spec

repo_info.description: Key Management System for the Zama Protocol.

children.title: Stoffel
children.description: A framework for robust MPC protocols which includes a custom compiler, VM runtime, SDKs targeted at developers with minimal MPC knowledge.

children.title: MPC Framework
children.description: TypeScript framework for doing MPC with multiple techniques for generating circuits and MPC backends. In particular, it supports summon circuits and emp-wasm-backend for malicious secure 2PC.

repo_info.description: Create MPC apps with TypeScript.

children.title: HPMPC
children.description: HPMPC implements multiple MPC protocols and provides a high-level C++ interface to define functions and use cases. Out of the box, the framework supports computation in the boolean and arithmetic domain, mixed circuits, and fixed point arithmetic. Neural network models can be imported from PyTorch as part of PIGEON.

repo_info.description: High Performance Implementation of Secure Multiparty Computation protocols

children.title: ORQ
children.description: General framework for relational analytics written in C++; includes fast sorting implementations and supports multiple protocols. | SOSP'25

repo_info.description: ORQ is a system for collaborative analytics under multiparty computation. [SOSP '25]

children.title: Velox
children.description: Post-Quantum asynchronous MPC implemented in Rust. Offers Fairness against $t<\frac{n}{3}$ malicious parties. Scales to $n=100$ parties in a geo-distributed network. | eprint: 2025/1630.

repo_info.description: Anonymous Broadcast using Asynchronous Multi-Party Computation from Lightweight Cryptography

children.title: LibOTe
children.description: Library with various OT Extensions.

repo_info.description: A fast, portable, and easy to use Oblivious Transfer Library

children.title: SCAPI
children.description: Various secure computation API's carefully documented with a clean code design in mind. | 2012/629.

repo_info.description: Comprehensive Open Source Library for Secure Multiparty Computation

children.title: TSS
children.description: A pure-Rust implementation of various threshold secret sharing schemes.

repo_info.description: A pure-Rust implementation of various threshold secret sharing schemes

children.title: OT Extension
children.description: OT Extension secure against malicious adversaries. | 2015/061.

repo_info.description: C++ OT extension implementation

children.title: Distributed Vector-OLE

repo_info.description: A two-party generator for Vector-OLE correlations.

children.title: APRICOT
children.description: OT Extension secure against malicious adversaries. | 2015/546.

repo_info.description: APRICOT: Advanced Protocols for Real-world Implementation of Computational Oblivious Transfers

children.title: SplitCommit
children.description: Additively homomorphic commitment scheme. | 2015/694.

repo_info.description: A portable C++ implementation of the [FJNT16] XOR-homomorphic commitment scheme

children.title: aes-prng
children.description: Rust pseudo-random number generator based on AES.

repo_info.description: Rust pseudo-random number generator based on AES

children.description: Multiparty ECDSA signing in the cryptocurrency setting, includes an optimized GC library, OT, and more. | CCS'18.

repo_info.description: Protecting cryptographic signing keys and seed secrets with Multi-Party Computation.

children.title: Fireblocks MPC
children.description: Multiparty ECDSA and EdDSA | eprint 2020/492.

children.title: PSI
children.description: Private Set Intersection. | 2014/447.

repo_info.description: Implementations of Private Set Intersection Protocols

repo_info.description: INACTIVE -  A C library implementing a basic version of the Prio system for private aggregation. https://crypto.stanford.edu/prio/

repo_info.description: A Secure Multiparty Computation (MPC) protocol for computing linear regression on vertically distributed datasets.

repo_info.description: Pinocchio-based adaptive zk-SNARK and distributed computation

repo_info.description: Read-Only Oblivious Maps and applications to multi-party machine learning on sparse data.

children.title: MPC-SoK

children.description: Logic Synthesis and Sequential Descriptions for Yao's Garbled Circuits. | S&P'15.

repo_info.description: TinyGarble: Logic Synthesis and Sequential Descriptions for Yao's Garbled Circuits

children.title: Conclave
children.description: Big Data query compiler that combines cleartext processing with Spark and MPC protocols. | EuroSys19.

repo_info.description: Query compiler for secure multi-party computation.

children.title: Circom 2 Arithc
children.description: Compiles bristol circuits for MPC from circom code.

repo_info.description: Circom interpreter to arithmetic circuit description

children.title: Garble-Lang
children.description: Programming language for MPC with Garbled Circuits. Garble is statically typed, low-level, purely functional and uses a syntax heavily inspired by Rust.

repo_info.description: Turing-Incomplete Programming Language for Multi-Party Computation with Garbled Circuits

children.title: UC Compiler
children.description: Valiant's Universal Circuit Compiler. | 2016/093.

repo_info.description: Implementation of Valiant's universal circuit construction optimized for private function evaluation

children.title: Summon
children.description: A TypeScript-like language for compiling bristol circuits for MPC. Also available as an npm module.

repo_info.description: A language for building boolean circuits based on TypeScript

children.title: CipherCompute
children.description: Create generic MPC programs using Rust. Works on top of the SCALE engine. Enterprise software that provides UIs for participants handshaking, computations approval, datasources connections, auditing etc...

repo_info.description: The free EAP version of the Cosmian Collaborative Confidential Computing platform. Try it!

children.title: Private Benchmarking
children.description: Provides an End to End platform to perform Private Benchmarking using MPC and GPU-based Confidential Computing on LLMs/CNNs/Vision Models using EzPC framework. | eprint.

repo_info.description: A platform that enables users to perform private benchmarking of machine learning models. The platform facilitates the evaluation of models based on different trust levels between the model owners and the dataset owners.

children.title: CrypTen
children.description: MPC with secret sharing; secure against semi-honest adversary; focused on building PyTorch applications. | documentation: link

repo_info.description: A framework for Privacy Preserving Machine Learning

children.title: Rosetta
children.description: 3PC with secret sharing; secure against semi-honest adversaries; focused on reusing the APIs of TensorFlow and allowing to transfer traditional TensorFlow codes into a privacy-preserving manner with minimal changes.

repo_info.description: A Privacy-Preserving Framework Based on TensorFlow

children.title: ABY
children.description: 2PC with secret sharing and garbled circuits; secure against semi-honest adversaries. | NDSS'15.

repo_info.description: ABY - A Framework for Efficient Mixed-protocol Secure Two-party Computation

children.title: EzPC
children.description: Offers a suite of tools for secure machine learning using semi-honest MPC protocols. It includes a language for secure machine learning, compilers for TensorFlow/Onnx to various MPC protocols, and frameworks for training and inference on deep neural networks. It provides an end-to-end solution for secure machine learning. | documentation: link. End-to-End Platform: link
